title: Udyam Registration — MSME Classification
authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
version: 2020 MSME classification criteria (verify for later revisions)
notes: MSME classification is officially based on BOTH investment and turnover; Business does not yet model investment, so this rule only checks the turnover ceiling. MSME classification limits have been revised more than once since 2020 -- verify current figures on udyamregistration.gov.in before relying on this for a real classification decision.
